before_blocks.label: text
before_blocks.text: Our assessment of the data supports that the Applicant established the analytical component of the scientific bridge between ABP 654, US-Stelara, and EU-Stelara, using the same methods and statistical approaches used to evaluate that ABP 654 is highly similar to US-Stelara. This supports the relevance of the data generated from clinical studies using EU-Stelara as the comparator for the assessment of biosimilarity.
